requirement: Describe SPECTRI/GX29185 as a Phase III, multicenter, randomized, double-masked, sham-injection-controlled, 96-week parallel study of intravitreal lampalizumab in geographic atrophy secondary to age-related macular degeneration.

evidence.text: The protocol synopsis states the phase, masking, control, disease, route and 96-week treatment period.
The SAP confirms the same design for GX29185/SPECTRI.

requirement: Specify IxRS permuted-block randomization in a 2:1:2:1 ratio to lampalizumab 10 mg Q4W, sham Q4W, lampalizumab 10 mg Q6W or sham Q6W, pooling the two sham arms for analysis and stratifying by CFI-profile biomarker status, baseline BCVA category, sex and microperimetry eligibility.

evidence.text: The protocol defines four arms, pooled sham comparisons and randomization stratification.
The SAP gives the 2:1:2:1 IxRS allocation and permuted-block stratification.

requirement: Report approximately 936 randomized patients, including 312 per active dosing arm and 156 per sham-frequency arm, a targeted 1.5:1 biomarker-positive-to-negative enrollment ratio, and a 15% Week-48 dropout assumption; distinguish the original sizing assumptions from the later power recalculation rather than changing the planned sample.

evidence.text: The protocol gives planned enrollment, biomarker allocation and power assumptions.
The SAP confirms the unchanged sample and provides revised power estimates from GX29633.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as absolute change from baseline in study-eye geographic-atrophy area at Week 48, measured by fundus autofluorescence and evaluated by the masked central reading center, with a smaller increase favoring lampalizumab.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the Week-48 FAF primary endpoint and central image evaluation.
The SAP confirms the variable, timepoint and analysis scope.

requirement: Separate the primary Week-48 analysis from the final Week-96 analysis and apply the SAP data cutoffs: Day 350 for non-imaging Q4W assessments, Day 357 for non-imaging Q6W assessments, and Day 384 for imaging and microperimetry.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies analysis timing and the treatment-frequency-specific Week-48 cutoffs.

notes: The exact cutoff days are SAP-only operational decisions and are not hidden protocol-only requirements.

requirement: Use all randomized patients as the ITT population for efficacy, grouped by randomized treatment; retain available efficacy data after treatment discontinuation when study assessments continue.

evidence.text: The protocol defines all randomized patients as ITT and assigns them by randomized treatment.
The SAP confirms ITT and inclusion of available data despite early treatment discontinuation.

requirement: Define the safety-evaluable population as all patients receiving at least one lampalizumab or sham injection and attribute safety to actual treatment, classifying anyone receiving lampalizumab as active at the randomized frequency while retaining sham-only patients in their randomized sham frequency.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the treated safety set and as-treated attribution.
The SAP operationalizes attribution for dosing errors.

requirement: Define baseline as the last available pre-treatment value on or before randomization; use the IxRS BCVA category when the corresponding baseline eCRF value is unavailable, and exclude a patient from an endpoint's change analysis if its baseline or all post-baseline values are absent.

evidence.text: The SAP fixes baseline and the fallback and endpoint-level inclusion rules.

requirement: Analyze the primary endpoint through Week 48 with an ITT data-as-observed MMRM containing treatment, categorical visit, treatment-by-visit interaction, baseline GA area and applicable stratification/baseline covariates; use unstructured within-patient covariance and heterogeneous compound symmetry if it fails to converge.

evidence.text: The protocol prespecifies a repeated-measures mixed model and no primary imputation.
The SAP supplies the final MMRM terms, covariance and convergence fallback.

requirement: For each active frequency versus pooled sham, report the Week-48 adjusted mean treatment difference in change from baseline, two-sided 95% confidence interval and p-value in the overall population; repeat the model separately in biomarker-positive and biomarker-negative groups without biomarker status as a model term.

evidence.text: The SAP defines overall and biomarker-specific estimates and outputs.

requirement: Apply the final SAP fixed sequence at two-sided alpha 0.0496: Q4W overall, Q4W biomarker-positive, Q6W overall, then Q6W biomarker-positive, advancing only after every preceding test passes; define study success as rejection of the first Q4W-overall hypothesis.

evidence.text: SAP Version 3 replaces the protocol hierarchy with four ordered hypotheses and defines the positive-study rule.

notes: This post-protocol hierarchy is confirmed_decisions only because SAP Version 3 explicitly supersedes Protocol Version 6.

requirement: Use two-sided alpha 0.0496 for formal Week-48 primary and Week-96 key-secondary testing, reflecting four nominal 0.0001 penalties for pre-primary iDMC unmasked reviews; treat Week-48 secondary and exploratory analyses as exploratory.

evidence.text: The SAP explains the iDMC penalty and analysis-specific alpha and timing.

requirement: Use all observed continuous-outcome data in the primary MMRM under MAR without single imputation; summarize discontinuation and reasons by arm, analyze binary endpoints at each timepoint using observed data unless otherwise specified, and follow instrument manuals for item-level missing patient-reported outcomes.

evidence.text: The protocol uses available observations with mixed modeling under MAR.
The SAP distinguishes continuous, binary, form-level and item-level missingness.

requirement: Assess primary-result robustness with 100-imputation MCMC and regression MAR analyses, control-based pattern-mixture MNAR and treatment-arm tipping-point MNAR analyses; linearly interpolate intermittent gaps before imputing monotone increments and analyze and pool each completed dataset using the primary model.

evidence.text: The SAP gives four multiple-imputation families, preprocessing, replication and pooling rules.

requirement: Include observed-data Week-48 sensitivity analyses using ANCOVA and a Van Elteren test, plus supplemental analyses of GA growth slope, square-root-transformed GA area and percent change in GA area.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies alternative observed-data models and supplemental derivations.

requirement: Cover the key Week-96 visual-function endpoints in order: absolute scotomatous points by microperimetry, low-luminance visual acuity, and binocular maximum reading speed; keep the broader BCVA, reading, NEI VFQ-25 and FRI outcomes secondary or exploratory rather than primary.

evidence.text: The protocol lists secondary visual-function outcomes.
The SAP identifies the three ordered key secondary endpoints and wider endpoint families.

requirement: Gate Week-96 key-secondary testing on the corresponding successful primary dose/population result, use fixed sequence at two-sided alpha 0.0496, base the first microperimetry inference on pooled GX29176/GX29185 data, and require that pooled test to pass before study-level LLVA and then reading-speed testing.

evidence.text: The SAP defines the cross-study microperimetry gate and within-study continuation order.

notes: The independent plan for the companion study is not model-visible; only the cross-study gate documented here is binding.

requirement: Summarize Week-48 and cumulative Week-96 safety by actual treatment, including systemic and ocular TEAEs separately by eye, severity, seriousness, relatedness, discontinuation/interruption, AESIs and deaths; define TEAEs from first dose and conservatively count missing or qualifying partially missing onset dates as treatment emergent.

evidence.text: The protocol defines safety scope, attribution and TEAE concept.
The SAP supplies timing, missing-date handling and detailed safety summaries.

requirement: Summarize serum and optional aqueous-humor lampalizumab concentrations and aqueous complement factor D by timepoint using actual treatment, with noncompartmental, exposure-response or population PK/PK-PD work only when supported and otherwise reported under separate prespecified plans.

evidence.text: The protocol defines systemic PK and descriptive concentration analysis.
The SAP adds aqueous PK/PD and conditions any modeling on separate plans.

requirement: State that no formal efficacy or futility interim analysis is planned; describe ongoing approximately six-monthly iDMC safety and conduct review, with possible safety stopping and the already-accounted nominal alpha penalty for unmasked reports.

evidence.text: The protocol states that iDMC review is not a formal efficacy/futility analysis.
The SAP confirms no formal interim analysis and describes the review-related penalty.

requirement: Explicitly flag that Protocol Version 6 and later SAP Version 3 use different primary hypothesis populations and order; before a protocol-only plan is locked, confirm whether to retain the protocol's biomarker-first sequence or adopt the later overall-population-first sequence, alpha 0.0496 and positive-study rule.

evidence.text: Protocol Version 6 starts primary testing with Q4W biomarker-positive and includes biomarker-negative comparisons.
SAP Version 3 explicitly supersedes the protocol and starts with Q4W overall, then biomarker-positive.

notes: The model must surface this amendment-era decision instead of guessing from the protocol.

requirement: Confirm the estimand attributes and handling of intercurrent events not fully named in the sources, including data after rescue or prohibited therapy, death and missing Week-48 imaging; also confirm MMRM degrees-of-freedom estimation and whether treatment discontinuation remains a treatment-policy strategy in every primary contrast.
acceptable_values: confirm rescue and prohibited therapy handling

evidence.text: The SAP includes available post-discontinuation data and extensive missing-data sensitivities but does not express a complete ICH E9(R1) estimand or all implementation details.
